Massive Build.description:
💪 Build: Massive Build
Exceptionally large across every dimension — towering height combined with extreme breadth and weight. Dominates any space.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Massive Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Massive frame — extremely large overall scale, towering and wide. Shoulders, chest, and limbs all oversized, the body dominates the composition by sheer volume. Female: shoulders enormously wide above a marked waist, thick neck, full jaw, the chest line above a broad waist. Male: everything oversized, neck and jaw heavy, an enormous flat chest. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at towering scale.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
